title: Electrostatic skeletons and condition of strict descent
summary: Given a precompact domain $Ω\subseteq\mathbb{R}^2$, the electrostatic skeleton of $Ω$ is defined as a positive measure inside $Ω$, supported on a set with no simple loops, which generates $\partial Ω$ as an equipotential curve. Eremenko conjectured that every convex polygon admits a unique electrostatic skeleton. This conjecture has since been proven for triangles and regular polygons. In this paper, we will prove the conjecture for quadrilaterals with a line of symmetry using arguments from conformal geometry.
